{{Quote|We were assigned to the Republic medium cruiser ''Halleck'', on station in the Ventran system. ''[&hellip;]'' We weren't supposed to know why we were there, naturally; just as naturally, we knew anyway. It was clear this would be a VIP extraction on a hostile planet.|Seven-Four|<ref name="Equipment">{{StoryCite|story=Equipment (short story)|book=Star Wars: Short Story Collection}}</ref>}}
The '''Ventran system''' was a [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located on the [[Gevarno Loop]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] set. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the system was loyal to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], and the Republic [[Cruiser/Legends|medium cruiser]] ''[[Halleck]]'' was stationed there in [[22 BBY/Legends|21.51 BBY]], until it was summoned by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Haruun Kal/Legends|Haruun Kal]] for [[Battle of Haruun Kal/Legends|extraction]].

==Description==
{{Quote|Ventran is on the Gevarno Loop, one of half a dozen systems linked by hyperspace lanes that run through Al'har ''[sic]''.|Seven-Four|<ref name="Equipment" />}}
The Ventran system was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Var Hagen sector/Legends|Var Hagen sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of the [[Trailing Sectors/Legends|Trailing Sectors]] portion of<ref name="TrailingSectors" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="TEA" /> The collection of [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]] known as the [[Gevarno Loop]] connected the Ventran system to the [[Killisu system/Legends|Killisu]], [[Jutrand system/Legends|Jutrand]], [[Loposi system/Legends|Loposi]], [[Opari system/Legends|Opari]], and [[Ch'manss system/Legends|Ch'manss systems]], as well as the [[Gevarno Cluster/Legends|Gevarno Cluster]]. Due to local [[Star/Legends|star]] configuration, a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] traveling between any two systems on the Gevarno Loop could decrease its journey [[Time/Legends|time]] by [[Standard day/Legends|days]] if it transited through the [[Al'Har system]]<ref name="Shatterpoint" /> in the [[Dustig sector/Legends|Dustig sector]].<ref name="EAOC" />

==History==
{{Quote|This is what we knew: If nothing went wrong, we wouldn't have anything to do. We'd cruise our station in the Ventran system for a week or two, then jump back for reassignment. Something went wrong.|Seven-Four|<ref name="Equipment" />}}
[[File:VarHagen.jpg|thumb|right|300px|The Ventran system was part of the Var Hagen sector (depicted on map) and remained loyal to the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars.]]
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a conflict between the<ref name="Shatterpoint" /> [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]<ref name="TEA" /> and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], the Ventran system remained loyal to the Republic. Although the Republic did not see any particular strategic value in the Ventran system, it was nonetheless determined to protect the system against any [[Confederacy military/Legends|military]] action by the Confederacy due to the high number of former Republic member systems that had already seceded during the conflict.<ref name="Shatterpoint" />

In [[22 BBY/Legends|21.51 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> when [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] traveled to the [[Summertime War|conflict]]-torn [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Haruun Kal/Legends|Haruun Kal]] in the Al'Har system on a mission to extract the missing fellow [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Depa Billaba/Legends|Depa Billaba]],<ref name="Shatterpoint" /> Windu journeyed aboard the Republic<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|9|''Halleck''}}</ref> [[Cruiser/Legends|medium cruiser]]<ref name="Shatterpoint" /> ''[[Halleck]]''.<ref name="CSWE" /> After that, the cruiser was stationed in the Ventran system with a [[Regiment/Legends|regiment]] of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] aboard.<ref name="Shatterpoint" />

Unless the Jedi Master encountered any problems during his mission, the ''Halleck'' was supposed to cruise its station in the Ventran system for one or two [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]] before leaving the system for reassignment.<ref name="Equipment" /> Eventually, Windu did signal the ''Halleck'' for extraction, and the medium cruiser traveled to the Al'Har system, where it participated in a [[Battle of Haruun Kal/Legends|battle]] against Confederate forces.<ref name="Shatterpoint" /> Later, the [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]] [[Seven-Four]] reported the ''Halleck''{{'s}} time spent in the Ventran system in a personal account of the engagement at the Al'Har system.<ref name="Equipment" /> The Ventran system was also mentioned in an entry&mdash;allegedly authored by Windu&mdash;of ''[[The Private Journals of Mace Windu]]'', which were published shortly after the Republic's [[Operation: Knightfall/Legends|razing]] of the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]. The entry was later included in [[Jedi historian]] [[Tionne Solusar]]'s [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]] compendium, ''[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force]]''.<ref name="JvS">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Ventran system was first mentioned in the [[2003]] novel [[Shatterpoint (novel)|''Shatterpoint'']], written by [[Matthew Stover]].<ref name="Shatterpoint" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the system in grid square M-16.<ref name="TEA" />
